summary.text: Stephanie Sauder is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 4 who took office on January 14, 2025, after serving in the state House from 2023 to 2025.
A former educator and mayor of Bryant, she advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Sauder earned a bachelor's degree in education from Dakota State University in 1990 and a master's degree in K-12 educational leadership and administration from Northern State University in 2012.

Her career experience includes working as a K-12 educator with the Hamlin School District, a training officer with the South Dakota Department of Education, and a newspaper editor with the Hamlin Co. Herald Enterprise.
She also served as mayor of Bryant, South Dakota.
In the House, Sauder served on the Agriculture and Natural Resources, Education, and Military and Veterans' Affairs committees.
In the 2025-2026 Senate session she serves on the Education and Transportation committees.
